source_review.identity: Printed 000 XM441 and LM REG TO XY REG BITS 42-43-44 VIA MIXER match the source filename and title block.
source_review.coverage: Inspected full native overview and UTF-8 preview, plus enlarged native crops covering the three receiver chains, all mixer groups, four format rails, output continuations, bit 19 branch and footer.
key_findings: Three 4060 AR/N receiver chains preserve distinct polarity outputs. Twelve 0505 A portions feed three OR/R groups for XY bits 42, 43 and 44.
The bit 19 native diamond branches to both AX.D10 and AN.D07; the preview preserves both connections and does not join unrelated crossings.
Four format rails feed the printed lower A inputs and their diamond joins match the native source.
The XX431/XX471 output references, continuation lists, card portion pins, footer connector legend, dates and part number match the scan.
A1 lists 26 card portions under XM441, but two are the 4060H1/H2 physical portions printed on XM411. All 24 portions printed on XM441 match direct A1 entries.
source_review.validation: Local validator PASS: 24/24 printed card portions matched to direct A1 entries, 45 printed input terminals, no unsupported characters, disconnected nets, hidden junctions or unreadable characters.

invalidation: Any change to source or an accepted artifact requires a new native and preview audit before acceptance.
